title: favicon-generator config

$schema.description: Path or URL of this JSON Schema, for editor support.

input.description:
Source image (SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP; should be square), or a Figma link
with a `node-id`, which is exported as SVG through the Figma REST API.

output.description: Directory to write the generated files into. Default: `favicons`.

overwrite.description: Overwrite existing files in the output directory. Default: `false`.

pathPrefix.description: URL prefix the files will be served from, e.g. `/favicons/`. Default: `/`.

snippets.description: Head snippets to write next to the icons; `[]` writes none. Default: `["html"]`.

appleTouchIcon.description: `apple-touch-icon.png`, 180×180 and opaque. Included by default; `false` leaves it out.

manifest.description: Adds a web app manifest (`manifest.json`) with 192 and 512 px icons: `true` or its options.

windows.description: Adds `browserconfig.xml` and tile images for pinned sites on Windows: `true` or its options.

legacy.description:
Also generate the sizes old browsers and devices look for: 19 PNG sizes,
sized Apple touch icons and a 7-frame `favicon.ico`. Default: `false`.

cache.description:
Reuse the generated files while the input and the options are
unchanged, and a Figma export while the Figma file is unchanged.
Default: `true`.

cacheDir.description:
Directory for the cache. Default: `node_modules/.cache/favicon-generator`
in the project root, if it has a `node_modules` directory.

figmaToken.description:
Figma personal access token (scope `file_content:read`). Prefer the
`FIGMA_TOKEN` env var or `figmaTokenFile` over committing a token.

figmaTokenFile.description: File containing the Figma personal access token.

oneOf.description: favicon-head.json with the tags as `{ link: [...], meta: [...] }`.

AppleTouchIconConfig.description: Options of the Apple touch icon.

background.description: Color behind transparent pixels; iOS shows them black. Default: `#ffffff`.

ManifestConfig.description: Options of the web app manifest. Only the fields you set are written.

backgroundColor.description: `background_color` of the splash screen; also behind maskable icons.

maskable.description:
Add maskable icons (the image at 60% on `backgroundColor`, one per icon size) for Android.
Default: `false`.

iconSizes.description: Sizes of the icons listed in the manifest, in px. Default: `[192, 512]`.

iconPurpose.description: `purpose` of the manifest icons, e.g. `any maskable`. Not set by default.
